name: BUBU2 accumulated burn rounds drain the BUBU2/WBNB pair after the owner cut the trigger interval to 120 seconds
summary: BUBU2's transfer hook burned 0.5% of the pair's BUBU2 per elapsed TRIGGER_INTERVAL, uncapped, then synced the pair. After the owner cut the interval to 120 s, 6.7 hours without a trigger accrued 199 rounds; the attacker flash-borrowed WBNB, bought BUBU2, fired the burn with a self-transfer that removed 99.5% of the pair's BUBU2, and sold back.
notes: setTriggerInterval(120) is the reset: at the default 6 h the elapsed time yields one 0.5% round, not 199. The owner's setBurnAndMintSwitch(true) 54 blocks later only switched the burn engine on, a gate rather than a HIGH field (rule 8); the lastTriggerTime it wrote is a live value later triggers overwrite.

Loss is the pair's whole WBNB depletion: besides the attacker's take it includes 10.32 WBNB the token's own fee swap drew from the pair at the manipulated price, which left the LPs even though it went to the project's fee wallet.
